facts.text: The party must bring Warwick the smith metal from the Dwarven mine to the north. This is their side of the bargain for the loan of his mithril shirt.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, which is on loan. Ingrid says it was his grandfather's armor and he never let even her touch it.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. It is on loan until the deal is settled.

Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral, and Sir Phidipaldi claims it is Sir Brandon's original. Warwick also keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to ward off his night visitors. The party can presumably reclaim the armor once the deal is settled.
facts.uncertain_reason: The terms for returning the armor and lyre were never spelled out.

facts.text: A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance and blocks getting metal for Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through. Dunk's shoulder-charges have partly opened it, uncovering a dead dwarf.
